nav.label: Settings sections
nav.deniedDescription: Your role does not include this section. A system admin can change what a role may open.

reasons.not_suitable: It is not suitable for a workplace.
reasons.offensive: It contains something offensive or threatening.
reasons.not_clear: It is too dark, blurred or small to see who is in it.

reasons.personal_information: It shows personal or confidential information, such as a document or a screen.

pictures.title: Profile pictures
pictures.intro: Approve or reject each picture before it replaces its owner's initials. You do not see your own here, and you cannot review it.

PENDING.title: Nothing is waiting for review
PENDING.description: New pictures appear here when someone sends one.

APPROVED.title: No approved pictures
APPROVED.description: Approved pictures appear here, so you can take one down later.

row.failed: This picture could not be loaded.

CHECKED.LOOKS_FINE: AI check: looks fine. The AI decided nothing.
CHECKED.NEEDS_A_CLOSER_LOOK: AI check: needs a closer look. The AI decided nothing.

NOT_ALLOWED.synthetic-data-only: Not checked by AI: only synthetic data may go to an AI tool.
NOT_ALLOWED.classification-not-allowed: Not checked by AI: this kind of data may not go to an AI tool.
NOT_ALLOWED.no-rule-for-provider: Not checked by AI: no data rule covers the AI tool in use.
NOT_ALLOWED.policy-unavailable: Not checked by AI: the data rule could not be read.
NOT_ALLOWED.other: Not checked by AI: the data rules do not allow it.

NOT_RUN.timeout: Not checked by AI: the AI did not answer in time.
NOT_RUN.failed: Not checked by AI: the check failed.
NOT_RUN.mock: Not checked by AI: only a scripted test answer came back, so nothing was examined.
NOT_RUN.other: Not checked by AI: the check did not run.

concern.unusable_image: the image is blank, dark or blurred

reject.title: Reject this picture?
reject.body: {{name}} will read the reason you choose. The picture is deleted.

takeDown.title: Take this picture down?
takeDown.body: {{name}} will read the reason you choose. Their initials show again and the picture is deleted.

dialog.noteHint: Up to 140 characters. {{name}} will read it.
dialog.needNote: Add a short note for this reason.

refusals.own_picture: You cannot review your own picture. Another administrator has to.
refusals.replaced: The person sent a newer picture. The list has been refreshed.
refusals.not_approved: This picture is no longer approved.

account.demoBody: This is a demo session with synthetic data. Use the Demo role button in the top bar to try another role.
account.managedBy: Your name and email are set by a system admin.

roleBlurb.SYSTEM_ADMIN: Sets up and checks OrderPilot. Does not approve, post or pay.
roleBlurb.PRODUCT_MANAGER: Raises stock purchase requests and follows your brands' orders and stock.
roleBlurb.APPROVER: Approves or rejects requests within your limit.
roleBlurb.SUPPORT: Confirms documents, keeps orders current, and prepares proforma invoices, invoices and packing lists.
roleBlurb.WAREHOUSE: Checks goods against the documents, then packs and releases them.
roleBlurb.FINANCE: Confirms payments, pays vendors, and clears payment holds with a second approver.
roleBlurb.LOGISTICS: Arranges forwarders and follows shipping dates, AWB or BL, and import permits.
roleBlurb.MANAGEMENT: Reads the tracker, dashboards and reports.

availability.label: Availability
availability.description: It changes nothing else: reminders, approvals and deadlines still reach you. It goes back to Available after {{hours}} hours.
availability.fellBack: It went back to Available after {{hours}} hours.
availability.demoShared: This is a shared demo account. Everyone who signs in as this role sees this availability and can change it.
availability.demoSeen: In this demo, the Demo role menu in the top bar shows it to the other accounts.
availability.footnote: Saved on the server, not on this device. It applies at once.

picture.title: Profile picture
picture.intro: Add a picture of yourself. A reviewer approves every picture first.
picture.none: You have no profile picture. Your initials show instead.
picture.approved: Approved on {{date}}. It replaces your initials in your menu and on this card. Other pages do not show it yet.
picture.pendingBody: Only you and the reviewers can see this picture until a reviewer approves it.
picture.pendingOwnReviewer: You may review pictures, but not your own. Another administrator has to review this one.

ai.CHECKED: An AI tool looked at it and told the reviewer what it saw. It decided nothing.
ai.NOT_ALLOWED: No AI tool looked at it: the data rules do not allow that today.
ai.NOT_RUN: No AI tool looked at it: the check did not complete.

picture.demoNote: This is a shared demo account. A picture you send waits for review and only you and the reviewers can see it. Once it is approved, everyone who signs in as this role sees it.

notice.REJECTED: Your last picture was not approved
notice.TAKEN_DOWN: A reviewer took your picture down
notice.deleted: The picture was deleted. Choose another one when you are ready.

picture.previewTitle: This is what the reviewer will see
picture.previewBody: It was cropped to a square and shrunk on your device. Camera details such as where it was taken were left out.
picture.removeBody: Your initials will show instead. You can send a new picture later.
picture.removeBodyWaiting: This picture will not be reviewed. You can send a new one later.
picture.left_one: You can send {{count}} more picture in the next 24 hours.
picture.left_other: You can send {{count}} more pictures in the next 24 hours.
picture.limitReached: You have used all {{limit}} uploads for now. Try again later.
picture.footnote: A reviewer is a person. An AI tool may describe the picture to the reviewer when the data rules allow it. It never approves or rejects.
picture.loadFailed: The picture could not be shown.

choiceErrors.not_an_image: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP picture.
choiceErrors.too_small: Choose a picture at least 128 pixels wide and high.
choiceErrors.too_large_file: Choose a picture smaller than 10 MB.
choiceErrors.cannot_read: This file could not be read as a picture.

refusals.wrong_type: Send the picture as a JPEG.
refusals.not_jpeg: This file is not a JPEG picture.
refusals.damaged: This picture file is damaged or incomplete.
refusals.unsupported: This kind of JPEG is not supported. Save it as a standard JPEG and try again.
refusals.wrong_size: The picture must be between 128 and 512 pixels wide.
refusals.cut_off: The upload was cut off. Try again.
refusals.too_big: This picture is larger than 256 KB. Choose a smaller one.
refusals.upload_limit: You have sent {{limit}} pictures in the last 24 hours. Try again later.
refusals.upload_busy: Another picture of yours is still being sent. Wait a moment and try again.
refusals.rejected_before: A reviewer did not approve this picture before. Choose a different one.

access.title: What you can do

access.none: Your role has no access yet. Ask a system admin to give you one.

access.everyRole: See what every role can do

session.title: Session
session.label: Sign out of OrderPilot
session.description: You are signed in as {{name}}. Signing out deletes any unsaved drafts on this device.

twoStep.title: Two-step verification

row.label: Authenticator app
row.descriptionOff: Ask for a 6-digit code from your phone when you sign in with your email and password.
row.descriptionOn: A 6-digit code from your phone is asked for each time you sign in with your email and password.

recovery.label: Recovery codes
recovery.low: Only {{count}} left. Make new codes soon.

twoStep.footnote: Saved on the server, not on this device. It applies at once.
twoStep.demoSkips: The demo role buttons skip this step, so a shared demo account is never locked.
twoStep.noPassword: This account has no password, so there is no email and password sign-in for two-step to protect.
twoStep.demoAdmin: A demo session cannot turn on two-step verification for this account, because only an administrator could undo it and an administrator cannot reset their own.
twoStep.recentLock: Too many wrong codes were entered for your account on {{date}}. If that was not you, someone may know your password.

setup.title: Turn on two-step verification
setup.demoWarning: This is a shared demo account. Two-step will apply to the email and password sign-in of this account for everyone who uses it.
setup.scanBody: In your authenticator app, add an account and scan this code.
setup.qrTitle: QR code for your authenticator app
setup.codeLabel: Then enter the 6-digit code it shows

recoveryView.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryView.body: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. They are shown only now.
recoveryView.copyFailed: The codes could not be copied. Select them and copy by hand.

disable.title: Turn off two-step verification
disable.body: Enter a code from your app, or a recovery code, to confirm.

regenerate.title: Make new recovery codes
regenerate.body: Enter a code from your app. The old recovery codes stop working.

menu.label: Side menu
menu.description: Automatic shows the compact menu on narrow windows and the full menu on wide ones.

tables.label: Saved table layouts
tables.description: The columns, their order and the views you saved in lists.
tables.none: There were no saved table layouts.

layout.footnote: Saved on this device. Other computers keep their own.

shortcuts.footnote: Letter keys do nothing while you are typing in a field. Shortcuts cannot be changed.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.intro: The AI reads, explains and drafts. A person confirms before anything is saved, sent or paid.

model.label: Model in use
model.mock: Scripted sample answers. No real model is used.

sees.label: What it can see
sees.description: Synthetic demo data only. No real customer or Spectra document is sent to an AI service.
sees.descriptionLive: The server's data policy decides what may be sent.

probe.label: Test the connection
probe.description: Sends one fixed sample question and shows how the AI answered. No document is sent. Each test is recorded in the audit log.
probe.okTokens: The AI answered in {{ms}} ms. It read {{input}} tokens and wrote {{output}}.
probe.error: The AI did not answer. Reason: {{code}}.
probe.refused: The request was refused before it was sent. Reason: {{code}}.
probe.timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Reason: {{code}}.
probe.failed: The test could not run. Trace id {{traceId}}.
probe.footnote: The provider and model are set on the server, not here.

people.description: See everyone who has an account. Admins can disable or enable people.

roles.description: See what each role can do.

audit.label: Audit log

monitoring.description: How OrderPilot is running, and what the AI costs.

health.title: System health

affects.title: What this affects
affects.database: Orders and documents cannot be saved or opened.
affects.redis: Background jobs, such as reading uploaded documents, are delayed.
affects.storage: Uploaded documents cannot be saved or opened.

health.footnote: The reason for a failure is in the server log.
